comments.author: @BeyondTheMapTV1
comments.text: Norway is a good example of why salary numbers mean very little without context. 🇳🇴💰 High wages coexist with expensive housing, food, transport and taxes, but they also help finance services that households in other countries often pay for separately. The interesting question is not simply how much people earn, but how much security and quality of life that income actually buys.
